_comment: Per-game fixes applied by pocknix-proton-wrapper on every launch (idempotent). Keys are Steam app ids. ini: ensure key=value under [section] in a file relative to the prefix (created if missing). args: appended to the game's command line. env: set unless already set. exe: run `to` instead of `from` (same directory). A launch option POCKNIX_GAME_FIXES=0 skips them.

ini.why: UE4 HttpManagerThread raises an exception Wine cannot dispatch (frame outside the stack) ~2 min in; the process dies back to the launcher. Both devices, 2026-10-08.

1245620.name: ELDEN RING
1245620.why: Easy Anti-Cheat's launcher fails ('Failed to load the anti-cheat module'); eldenring.exe itself runs and starts in offline mode. 2026-10-08.

379720.name: DOOM (2016)
379720.why: The default OpenGL renderer runs at about 1 fps on Turnip/Zink; Vulkan is 30x faster. 2026-10-08.

782330.name: DOOM Eternal
782330.why: The Chromium-based 'DOOM Eternal Launcher' sits at 'Compiling shaders...' and never starts the game; the game executable itself runs (title, Bethesda.net login). Mods need the launcher; plain play does not. 2026-10-08.
